_disclaimer: Default values are calibrated against a reference bugfest environment. See ADR-0013 (Module configuration management) for the governance model behind this file. Resource values and JAVA_OPTS heap limits reflect a dedicated Keycloak ECS task and must be adjusted to the target host capacity.

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the Keycloak container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the Keycloak container in MiB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the Keycloak container in MiB

deployment.description: Keycloak uses the embedded jdbc-ping Infinispan cluster stack for distributed cache synchronization. HA requires at least two replicas for cache redundancy; CACHE_OWNERS_COUNT=2 ensures each cache entry is replicated to a second node so a single-node loss does not cause cache data loss.

EnvVars.name: KC_DB
EnvVars.description: Database vendor; postgres is the only backend supported by the built image.

EnvVars.name: KC_DB_URL_HOST
EnvVars.description: Hostname of the PostgreSQL instance serving the Keycloak database.

EnvVars.name: KC_DB_URL_PORT
EnvVars.description: TCP port of the PostgreSQL instance.

EnvVars.name: KC_DB_URL_DATABASE
EnvVars.description: Name of the PostgreSQL database used by Keycloak.

EnvVars.name: KC_DB_USERNAME
EnvVars.description: Username for the Keycloak database connection.

EnvVars.name: KC_DB_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the Keycloak database connection.

EnvVars.name: KEYCLOAK_ADMIN
EnvVars.description: Username of the Keycloak bootstrap admin account created on first startup.

EnvVars.name: KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the Keycloak bootstrap admin account.

EnvVars.name: KC_FOLIO_BE_ADMIN_CLIENT_ID
EnvVars.description: Client ID of the FOLIO backend admin OAuth2 client created in the master realm by configure-realms.sh.

EnvVars.name: KC_FOLIO_BE_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET
EnvVars.description: Client secret for the FOLIO backend admin OAuth2 client; the container refuses to start without it.

EnvVars.name: KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_USERNAME
EnvVars.description: Admin username configure-realms.sh uses to authenticate against the Keycloak Admin REST API during bootstrap.

EnvVars.name: KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Admin password configure-realms.sh uses during bootstrap; falls back to KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD when unset.

EnvVars.name: KC_URL
EnvVars.description: Base URL configure-realms.sh uses to reach the local Keycloak Admin REST API.

EnvVars.name: KC_HOSTNAME
EnvVars.description: Public-facing hostname Keycloak advertises in tokens, redirects, and well-known endpoints. Required when KC_HOSTNAME_STRICT is true.

EnvVars.name: KC_HOSTNAME_STRICT
EnvVars.description: When true, Keycloak rejects requests whose Host header does not match KC_HOSTNAME.

EnvVars.name: KC_HOSTNAME_BACKCHANNEL_DYNAMIC
EnvVars.description: When true, Keycloak derives the backchannel URL from the incoming request rather than KC_HOSTNAME; useful in dynamic-IP cluster environments.

EnvVars.name: KC_PROXY
EnvVars.description: Reverse-proxy mode (deprecated in Keycloak 26; superseded by KC_PROXY_HEADERS). edge instructs Keycloak to trust X-Forwarded-* headers from a TLS-terminating proxy.

EnvVars.name: KC_PROXY_HEADERS
EnvVars.description: Header set forwarded by the reverse proxy. xforwarded enables parsing of X-Forwarded-For, X-Forwarded-Proto, and X-Forwarded-Host.

EnvVars.name: KC_HTTP_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables the plain-HTTP listener. Must be true when the container sits behind a TLS-terminating reverse proxy.

EnvVars.name: KC_HTTPS_KEY_STORE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Keystore format for the server TLS certificate. BCFKS is the BouncyCastle FIPS keystore format used by the image.

EnvVars.name: KC_HTTPS_KEY_STORE_FILE
EnvVars.description: Path to the keystore file used for the HTTPS listener.

EnvVars.name: KC_HTTPS_KEY_STORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password to unlock the HTTPS keystore. Replace the default with a secure value in all deployments.

EnvVars.name: KCADM_HTTPS_TRUST_STORE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Truststore format used by kcadm.sh when connecting to Keycloak over HTTPS.

EnvVars.name: KCADM_HTTPS_TRUST_STORE
EnvVars.description: Path to the truststore file used by kcadm.sh for TLS peer verification.

EnvVars.name: KCADM_HTTPS_TRUST_STORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password to unlock the kcadm truststore. Replace the default with a secure value in all deployments.

EnvVars.name: KC_LOG_LEVEL
EnvVars.description: Root log level for Keycloak. Accepts a comma-separated list of category:LEVEL pairs, e.g. INFO,org.keycloak.events:DEBUG.

EnvVars.name: KC_HEALTH_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Exposes /health, /health/live, and /health/ready endpoints used by container orchestrators for readiness and liveness probes.

EnvVars.name: KC_METRICS_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Exposes Prometheus-compatible metrics at /metrics.

EnvVars.name: KC_SPI_LOGIN_PROTOCOL__OPENID_CONNECT__ALLOW_TOKEN_INTROSPECTION_WITHOUT_AUDIENCE_CHECK
EnvVars.description: Allows token introspection when the requesting client is not listed in the token audience. Required for FOLIO compatibility; must remain true.

EnvVars.name: KC_SPI_LOGIN_PROTOCOL__OPENID_CONNECT__ALLOW_USERINFO_WITH_LIGHTWEIGHT_ACCESS_TOKEN
EnvVars.description: Allows the UserInfo endpoint to accept lightweight access tokens. Required for FOLIO lightweight-token support; must remain true.

EnvVars.name: KC_SPI_BRUTE_FORCE_PROTECTOR__DEFAULT_BRUTE_FORCE_DETECTOR__ALLOW_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS
EnvVars.description: Permits concurrent authentication requests per user without triggering brute-force lockout. Recommended for high-concurrency environments.

EnvVars.name: CONFIG_FILE
EnvVars.description: Name of the FOLIO configuration JSON file loaded by the container at startup.

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTS
EnvVars.description: JVM flags passed to the Keycloak process. Controls initial and maximum heap size; tune together with the container memory limit.

EnvVars.name: KC_CACHE_EMBEDDED_AUTHORIZATION_MAX_COUNT
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of authorization objects held in the embedded Infinispan cache. Increase for large numbers of clients or policies.

EnvVars.name: KC_CACHE_EMBEDDED_OFFLINE_SESSIONS_MAX_COUNT
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of offline user sessions held in the embedded Infinispan cache.

EnvVars.name: KC_CACHE_EMBEDDED_OFFLINE_CLIENT_SESSIONS_MAX_COUNT
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of offline client sessions held in the embedded Infinispan cache.

EnvVars.name: KC_CACHE_EMBEDDED_REALMS_MAX_COUNT
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of realm objects held in the embedded Infinispan cache. Set higher for multi-tenant deployments with many realms.

EnvVars.name: KC_CACHE_EMBEDDED_USERS_MAX_COUNT
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of user objects held in the embedded Infinispan cache.

EnvVars.name: KC_CACHE_METRICS_HISTOGRAMS_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables histogram metrics for the embedded Infinispan cache; adds latency distribution data to the /metrics output.

EnvVars.name: CACHE_OWNERS_COUNT
EnvVars.description: Number of Infinispan cluster nodes that hold a replica of each cache entry. Set to 2 or more to survive a single-node loss in HA deployments.

EnvVars.name: KC_RUN_MODE
EnvVars.description: Startup mode: prod runs start --optimized (pre-built image); dev runs start-dev without production hardening, suitable for local development only.

EnvVars.name: FIPS
EnvVars.description: When true, switches the container entrypoint to start-fips.sh, enabling FIPS 140-2 compliant cryptography via BouncyCastle.

EnvVars.name: IS_EUREKA
EnvVars.description: Signals to the FOLIO Keycloak SPI plugins that this instance is running within the FOLIO Eureka platform.

EnvVars.name: PLATFORM
EnvVars.description: Identifies the FOLIO platform variant consumed by the FOLIO Keycloak SPI plugins for platform-specific behaviour.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_PRODUCER_TENANT_COLLECTION
EnvVars.description: Determines which tenants the Kafka producer publishes tenant-lifecycle events to. ALL sends to every entitled tenant.
